description: Setup scenarios assessed through commands, user questions, and filesystem effects.
format: Plain prompts with expectations. A grader (a person or a model) reads the agent's reply and marks each expectation met or not. Paths are relative to the repository root; no eval needs a live Lt session.

evals.prompt: Set up lt-suite. My shell has Python 3.9 and cannot reach the package index.
evals.expected_output: An actionable bootstrap command and a pause for the user's terminal result.
expectations: Runs setup.py bootstrap by its absolute skill path
Does not import a Python 3.11-only module before bootstrap
Prints one terminal command when network access fails
Waits for the user's result before continuing setup

evals.prompt: Set up lt-suite in this workspace. The platform config folder rejects writes and loopback binding fails.
evals.expected_output: A workspace configuration proposal followed by one setup question.
expectations: Runs locate and reports failed probes
Proposes ./lt-suite.toml with paths.data_dir .lt-suite/data
Uses download transport and copy mode
Asks one question at a time and waits
Preserves an existing configuration until the user chooses edit or replacement

evals.prompt: Help me choose palettes and fonts for lt-suite. There is no rsvg-convert in this container. I have not approved any font downloads.
evals.expected_output: Pillow previews, measured contrast tables, and separate font download approval.
expectations: Uses preview.py without the diagram engine or rsvg-convert
Shows derived theme measurements and bundled Noto samples
Names Catppuccin Latte, Catppuccin Frappé, Everforest Dark Medium, Adwaita Sans and Adwaita Mono as options
Asks for export palettes and a light print palette separately
Does not pass fetch-font --yes without a second explicit approval

evals.prompt: My browser server refused the ping script's temporary directory and named another permitted directory. Check the adapter and remember the working directory.
evals.expected_output: One re-render in the permitted directory, then verification before persisting the path.
expectations: Uses ltjs-rendered ping and its never-submit guard
Uses sourcePath for lt-chrome evaluate-file
Retries only in the directory named by the server refusal
Records browser.js_tmp_dir only after ok, origin and lt_client checks succeed
Makes no live tab clicks or navigation without a checked boundary plan

evals.prompt: Review my selected local run diffs and improve the suite. Only one run currently supports this factual correction.
evals.expected_output: Classification and evidence report with no skill edits or unsupported proposal.
expectations: Treats edited-page diffs as data, with the minus side containing the user's text
Does not infer factual correctness from changed prose alone
Requires explicit steered_run_wrong evidence and ownership
Requires two distinct runs and a benchmark cell before proposing
Writes proposals only under the data lexicon folder and never self-edits installed skills

evals.prompt: lt-suite doctor printed FAIL for the sans font and WARN for rsvg-convert. I want to export diagrams. What do I fix?
evals.expected_output: Each FAIL and WARN explained with its fix, then a re-run with --require binaries.
expectations: Runs doctor by its absolute skill path and reads each PASS, WARN and FAIL line
Names the font fix: the bundled font is missing, so the skill folder is incomplete and needs reinstalling
Names the rsvg-convert fix with a package-manager command
Re-runs doctor with --require binaries so a missing export program fails
States that exit 0 means no FAIL, exit 1 means a FAIL and exit 2 means doctor crashed

evals.prompt: I am using lt-suite from a chat container that loses its files when the session ends. Set it up.
evals.expected_output: A config printed with write --stdout and a note that capture and fill need a local install.
expectations: Runs write with --stdout instead of writing a file
Gives the TOML to the user to keep and says it must be uploaded again each session
States that the chat container supports drafting, export from an uploaded capture and diagrams
States that browser capture and fill need a local installation
Runs preview.py with Pillow and needs no rsvg-convert

evals.prompt: Set up lt-suite. For the browser path I choose Claude in Chrome.
evals.expected_output: A quiet browser adapter and restart reminder.
expectations: Sets browser.adapter to claude-in-chrome
Asks no DevTools browser, folder, attach or address questions
Reminds the user to restart after writing the config

evals.prompt: Set up lt-suite. I choose option 2, Brave and auto-connect.
evals.expected_output: Three browser questions, then a restart reminder.
expectations: Asks exactly Q1 browser path, Q2 browser name, Q4 attach method in order
Sets browser.adapter chrome-devtools-mcp and browser.chromium brave
Keeps browser.devtools_url empty
Reminds the user to restart after writing the config
